name: High Level Alchemy: Scenarios
source:
An anthology of action and slice-of-life short stories, following a group of not-so-"good" Alchemists, navigating brutal and bloody battles and the messy reality of living alongside each other.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4910940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部融合热血动作与日常百态的短篇故事集，讲述一群算不上什么“善茬”的炼金术士在残酷血腥的厮杀与鸡飞狗跳的同居现实之间摸爬滚打的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4910940/]Steam[/url]]
